attribute_values.details: Gene knock in. One-for-one substitution of DNA sequence information in a genetic locus or the insertion of sequence information not found within the locus.

attribute_values.name: CRISPR-mediated
attribute_values.details: A CRISPR-associated (Cas) enzyme is used to cleave target DNA, resulting in a double-strand break (DSB). The Cas enzyme is directed by the guide RNA (gRNA) to a user-defined site in the genome, and then the Cas enzyme cuts the DNA.

attribute_values.name: CRSPR+HDR mediated
attribute_values.details: HDR is an acronym for homology-directed repair, one of the common mechanisms for DNA double-strand break repair in eukaryotes. HDR can be used as part of CRISPR-mediated editing to introduce an exogenous DNA repair template composed of homology arms flanking a sequence of interest.

attribute_values.name: BiggyBac transposon
attribute_values.details: The PiggyBac (PB) transposon is a mobile genetic element that efficiently transposes between vectors and chromosomes via a 'cut and paste' mechanism. During transposition, the PB transposase recognizes transposon-specific inverted terminal repeat sequences (ITRs) located on both ends of the transposon vector and efficiently moves the contents from the original sites and integrates them into TTAA chromosomal sites
